articles.title: Metallus: Q4 Earnings Snapshot
articles.summary: The Canton, Ohio-based company said it had a loss of 34 cents per share. Losses, adjusted for one-time gains and costs, came to 18 cents per share. The maker of steel large bars and seamless mechanical tubing posted revenue of $267.3 million in the period.

articles.title: Metallus Announces Fourth-Quarter and Full-Year 2025 Results
articles.summary: Metallus (NYSE: MTUS), a leader in high-quality specialty metals, manufactured components and supply chain solutions, today reported fourth-quarter 2025 net sales of $267.3 million and net loss of $14.3 million, or a loss of $0.34 per diluted share. On an adjusted basis(2), the fourth-quarter 2025 net loss was $7.7 million, or a loss of $0.18 per diluted share, and adjusted EBITDA was $2.4 million.
